Subject: Calendar .ics offset correction — request to reschedule demo

Hi Lee —

Thanks for your patience this morning. I wanted to follow up because it looks like the calendar invite I sent for our demo was exported with UTC timestamps in the .ics (my bad) which shifted the meeting for folks whose clients are on BST/local time. That mismatch is why you likely saw a different start time in your calendar.

I've attached a corrected .ics ("corrected-invite-2026-08-04.ics") that explicitly sets the event in BST and in your Outlook/Gmail it should appear at the local time. Would you be open to one of the following windows for a short 25-minute walkthrough? I can send a fresh invite in whichever slot you pick and confirm the timezone on the event text so we don't run into this again.

- Wed 4 Aug — 09:00–09:30 BST (04:00–04:30 EDT)
- Wed 4 Aug — 14:00–14:30 BST (09:00–09:30 EDT)
- Thu 5 Aug — 11:00–11:30 BST (06:00–06:30 EDT)

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and I’ll match your timezone exactly. Apologies again for the confusion — I want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
